events.name: Inauguration
events.description: ACE held its inauguration ceremony for the academic year 2018-19, followed by a guest lecture from Mr. Sada Siva Sarma, Senior Principal Scientist at CSIR-CEERI. The previous year's (2017-18) ACE report was presented, and Dr. R. Anitha, HoD of the Computer Science Department, addressed the gathering. The event concluded with a vote of thanks and a memento presented to the chief guest.

events.name: Codemon
events.description: Codemon was an intense coding contest held for first, second and third year students, with compulsory participation for first years while second and third years registered separately. The preliminary round was conducted online via HackerEarth, and shortlisted participants competed on-campus using HackerRank. Second and third years faced a two-round format: an online coding round followed by a round requiring optimized solutions to real-life problems.
events.requirements: Two-round coding contest: an online preliminary round on HackerEarth, followed by an on-campus round on HackerRank where real-life problems required optimized coded solutions.

events.name: Women's Day
events.description: ACE organized an event to commemorate Women's Day for girl students of the Computer Science Department. Eleven two-member teams were shortlisted on a first-come-first-served basis after circulating registration forms. The event featured two rounds: Dumb Charades, where one teammate enacted a word for the other to guess within a time limit, and Pictionary, where the roles swapped and words were drawn on a whiteboard instead.
events.requirements: Round 1 (Dumb Charades): one team member enacts a word within 2 minutes for the other to guess. Round 2 (Pictionary): roles swap, and the word is drawn on a whiteboard within 3 minutes. Winners determined by combined score across both rounds.

events.name: Quiz
events.description: ACE organized a quiz event to recognize and motivate tech-savvy students in the department. Thirty-six students competed in two-member teams across four rounds testing general tech knowledge, logo identification, visual connections, and a final "Connect 4" round assessing visualization and interpretation skills.
events.requirements: Four rounds: (1) "What, When and Who" general questions, (2) logo identification and significance, (3) a long visual connect testing analytical skills, (4) "Connect 4" testing visualization and interpretation skills.

events.name: Talk on Deep Learning
events.description: The Department of CSE and ACE organized a guest lecture on "Deep Learning and its Industrial Applications" delivered by Mr. T. Srinivasan, CEO of Glosys Technology. He introduced second and third year students to machine learning and deep learning through real-world examples before explaining related concepts and technologies in depth. Prizes for events held during 2018-19 were also distributed by the speaker at this event.

events.name: Lecture on Entrepreneurship
events.description: The Department of CSE and ACE organized a guest lecture on entrepreneurship by Mr. Sathish Raj for over 120 second and third year attendees. He shared his own experiences and struggles in an interactive session covering how to start a company, and advised students on identifying their interests and choosing the right career path.

events.name: Git Workshop
events.description: ACE conducted a hands-on workshop on Git for second and third year students, hosted by third-year student ArjunAravind and assisted by second-years Yuvraj J and Shriram S G. Seventy participants, chosen on a first-come-first-served basis, were split into two batches of 35 for separate sessions covering basic Git commands and the GitHub workflow. The workshop concluded with an oral quiz to reinforce learning.
events.requirements: Hands-on sessions covering basic Git commands and GitHub workflow, followed by an oral quiz to check understanding.

events.name: Valedictory
events.description: ACE hosted a "Tech-Talk" for second-year students delivered by alumni Mr. Vikkram Anand, Mr. Vijay Vignesh, and chief guest Mr. Keshav Aditya R.P, covering Machine Learning, data visualization, data preprocessing, and web development and deployment. This was followed by the Valedictory ceremony, addressed by HoD Mrs. Anitha and the chief guest, and included presentation of the annual report with a recap video of the year's events. Mementos were given to the chief guest and coordinators, and prizes were distributed to the year's event winners.
